column8: Repair wrong decimal output for integers containing consecutive zero digits. Preserve the existing public API and no_std behavior.
Restore correct negative-infinity formatting for f32 and f64 without changing finite output.
Correct big-endian u16 decoding without breaking little-endian decoding or wider integer handling.
Repair sign extension for signed variable-width 64-bit and 128-bit reads in both byte orders. Preserve round trips at boundary widths.
